Several times, i've rediscovered a band who haven't played for over a decade and i would listen to their songs obsessively for a few days in a row (after having forgotten about them for several years) -- then low and behold i come across an article/person mentioning the band has reformed or is recording a new single or has suddenly announced a tour with my town on it. It baffles me. I've lost count of how many times this has happened. It's makes me smile when it does though.

Words are another one, just as you mention. In conversation, you might choose a rarely (or highly uncommon) word or phrase, and think nothing of it. But later in the day you see/hear it several times. Very odd when it happens to me, i just stop and freeze, and then grin like a crazy madman.

Another one, is dreaming about a person you know well -- like a best friend -- i was in a hospital a few years back doing some tests on my brain patterns (due to a sleep study), and i had a dream in the ward one night after falling asleep at around 10pm. It was a dream with one of my best friends i had slowly drifted away from over the preceding months, we hadn't spoken/contacted each other in ages. Anyway, the dream involved her sitting on the couch in her flat, there was no sound, but lip movement which i understood as her saying "how are you doing?" and then we had a conversation with audible words, mostly small talk. Here's where it gets creepy. My parents came to visit me the next day, when they arrived, they said my friend had phoned last night and asked how i was doing... i asked my mom "what time?" She said it was at around 10:30pm.

There's plenty of other small things (not as interesting) like standing at a roadside waiting for the lights to change... and getting a mental image of something bright orange (for example) and then within 2 or 3 seconds a cyclist shoots around the corner in bright orange lycra. If you are able to notice it as often as i tend to, it becomes laughable, almost hilarious. Because it makes no sense unless we are somehow all connected.

Is it all coincidence? I feel not.

I feel it shows that there is a connection of some kind, through consciousness or some other energy. Or like the saying... "the world is how you make it to be". If you believe something strong enough, it will happen, even if you are unaware of it. If you go along the idea that time is only an illusion, then everything that is, ever was, and ever will be -- is the very same moment.... we've already experienced it, and we can tap into that 'eternal shared memory' on a subconscious level. Hence we chose the words, or are attracted to an item, or even perform a certain act, because we already know how things will play out.

You could just say it is a subconscious awareness of fate, or destiny.
